terra.problem: Saying nobody has to guess who He is implies the passage names His identity. His answer describes Himself as proclaiming vindication and mighty to save, but does not name Him.
The explanation gives a Bible fact about grain being separated on a threshing floor without a reference. That fact is not in this passage.
Saying nobody else was in the picture or showed up goes beyond the text. It says no one helped or assisted, not that no one else was present.
